description: Documented CWE-78 sites in three public, deliberately vulnerable applications. Positives only: no site in these applications is labeled safe.
prepared: 2026-11-14, before any scan of these sources by this project

sites.evidence: docs/solution/a1-injection.md, section "Command Injection": names core/appHandler.js, quotes this call and shows the exploit "x ; id"
dsvw.py, CASES entry "Arbitrary Code Execution" with the exploit "/?domain=www.google.com; ifconfig"; this is the only use of the domain parameter
README.md, "Vulnerabilities in code" lists "Command execution" without naming a file; this is the only command built from request data in the application's own code, located by reading the source
